# Thorcast.AI

> AI predictive analytics for banks, insurers, telcos and retailers worldwide: credit scoring, churn, fraud and geo intelligence models built on enriched data, in minutes rather than months.

Thorcast.AI is a platform where AI agents take a predictive model from raw data to production: NORA prepares and joins the data, MJÖ builds and compares models autonomously, and the platform handles data enrichment, Champion–Challenger comparison, batch scoring, monitoring and recalibration. Models are explainable and documented for audit. Thorcast.AI serves organizations in any region: the Americas, Europe, Africa and Asia.

## Solutions (pages in Spanish)

- [Scoring crediticio con IA](https://thorcast.ai/scoring-crediticio-ia.html): credit scoring models with AI and alternative data for origination, collections and cutoff decisions.
- [Cómo elegir software de scoring crediticio](https://thorcast.ai/como-elegir-software-scoring-crediticio.html): Spanish buyer's guide: five types of credit scoring tools, ten evaluation criteria, how to run a fair proof of concept, red flags, and where Thorcast fits and does not.
- [Modelo de churn y fuga de clientes](https://thorcast.ai/modelo-churn-fuga-clientes.html): customer churn prediction for banking, insurance and telco.
- [Detección de fraude con machine learning](https://thorcast.ai/deteccion-fraude-machine-learning.html): fraud detection for credit applications, account takeover and insurance claims.
- [Inteligencia geográfica](https://thorcast.ai/inteligencia-geografica.html): block-level area profiles, points of interest and travel-time zones for expansion, geomarketing and territorial risk.

## Product

- [Home](https://thorcast.ai/): overview, use cases by industry (banking, life and health insurance, general insurance, insurance brokers, telco). Also in [Spanish](https://thorcast.ai/es.html) and [Portuguese](https://thorcast.ai/pt.html).
- [Tutorials](https://thorcast.ai/tutorials.html): video tutorials covering data preparation, enrichment, modeling, comparison, deployment and monitoring.
- [Our story](https://thorcast.ai/about.html): why Thorcast.AI was founded.
- [Who it's for](https://thorcast.ai/who-is-it-for.html): by industry, team size and region, and when Thorcast is not the best fit. Also in [Spanish](https://thorcast.ai/para-quien-es.html) and [Portuguese](https://thorcast.ai/para-quem-e.html).
- [FAQ](https://thorcast.ai/faq.html): what Thorcast.AI is, who it is for, where it runs, data enrichment, explainability, integrations, how to try it. [Spanish](https://thorcast.ai/preguntas-frecuentes.html).
